FAQ

Questions crews actually ask.

Most crews are rendering their first room within a day of signing up — there's no install, no hardware, and no training beyond the app itself.

Take a photo of any wall or room, pick a color, and Paintrz renders it finished — accounting for the room's real light and surface — in about ten seconds.

On Enterprise, Paintrz rolls into your existing CRM rather than replacing it, so every crew works the same way they already do.

Pay As You Go if you want to try it on one bid. Starter or Crew for a solo painter or small crew bidding regularly. Pro or Studio if you're running a busy crew or multiple crews on one shared standard.

Painting contractors — solo painters, crews, and multi-crew shops — who want the client's own room to do the selling instead of a pitch.

Yes — Paintr is the contracting crew, Paintrz is the software. Same painless promise, two different jobs.
